page_title: OVI 1-3 BAR | Oviedo v Barcelona 25/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Miguel Ortiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it.
90+2' Eric Bailly (R. Oviedo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+1' That's the end of the game for Marcus Rashford, who is replaced by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).
90+1' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Pedri and he is replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) on for Leander Dendoncker.

88' 1 - 3 Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Marcus Rashford. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:3.
88' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner.
88' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
87' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
85' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) swings it in and Robert Lewandowski gets on the end of it, but Aaron Escandell shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
83' Some patient build-up play from Barcelona as they look to unlock the defence.
81' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Ferran Torres (Barcelona) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
80' Miguel Ortiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) and blew his whistle. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.

79' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
77' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alberto Reina will be replaced by Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo).
75' Veljko Paunovic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Fores (R. Oviedo) replacing Ilyas Chaira.
75' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
73' Substitution. Gerard Martin makes way for Jules Kounde (Barcelona).
72' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Ahijado (R. Oviedo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
71' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from R. Oviedo was in an offside position.

70' 1 - 2 Frenkie de Jong displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it to the top right corner via the post. 1:2.
67' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
66' R. Oviedo are ruled offside.
65' Raphinha will be replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
65' Here is a change. Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) is going off and Veljko Paunovic gives the last tactical orders to Kwasi Sibo.
65' Substitution. Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) replaces Santi Cazorla.
63' Barcelona win a corner.

62' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and easily denies him.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. R. Oviedo can continue in their attacking effort.
59' One of the players from R. Oviedo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

59' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Aaron Escandell makes a comfortable save.
58' Raphinha (Barcelona) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Aaron Escandell.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! Eric Garcia (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
56' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
55' Raphinha (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
54' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
53' The linesman raises his flag. Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) is adjudged offside.
51' The players claim that Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
48' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from R. Oviedo was in an offside position.

48' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
47' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' The manager makes a subsitution with Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) coming on for Marc Casado.
46' Referee Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Barcelona are taking a throw-in.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
42' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Marc Casado (Barcelona).
41' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a long ball in, but Aaron Escandell comfortably gathers the ball.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
37' Good defending. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) tries to find Raphinha inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
36' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.
36' The ball possession is 28:72.
33' 1 - 0 A mix up in midfield presents the ball to Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) and he coolly lobs a stranded Joan Garcia from distance to make the score 1:0.
33' Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
32' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Aaron Escandell gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
32' Raphinha (Barcelona) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the right post! If it had flown more to the left it would have been a cracker!
31' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
29' Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) will deliver the corner kick.
29' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to R. Oviedo.
28' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
26' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
25' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
25' Wonderful pass from Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) for Aaron Escandell, but they can't profit from it as Joan Garcia comes off his line to collect.
23' Barcelona get a corner.
22' Aaron Escandell blocks a long-range effort from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) towards the roof of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
21' A crossfield pass from Raphinha (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for R. Oviedo.
19' The ball is behind the touchline and R. Oviedo will take a throw-in.
18' Lucas Ahijado (R. Oviedo) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
16' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
15' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Marc Casado (Barcelona) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
13' Referee Miguel Ortiz sees the trip by Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
11' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

10' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the left side of the target, but Aaron Escandell pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
9' A raking crossfield pass from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
8' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.

8' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
7' Joan Garcia leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo).
6' David Carmo (R. Oviedo) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
6' R. Oviedo earn a corner.
6' Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
5' The ball is cleared after Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. R. Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
4' Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
3' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!

2' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Miguel Ortiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
1' The first half has started.
R. Oviedo will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Miguel Ortiz.
